goal: Prevent network and HTTP event loops from busy-looping when sockets receive TCP urgent data
Avoid bypassing receive backpressure or causing failed send attempts when socket errors occur
agreement: Strong support for fixing P2P busy loops caused by TCP urgent data (darosior, midnightmagic)
Nonblocking preference to fail on error across all platforms without platform branching (darosior, theuni)
Open question regarding the rationale for directly disconnecting poll errors (darosior)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents peer event loops from entering busy loops on TCP urgent data
It also prevents bypassing receive backpressure when paused sockets encounter errors

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it prevents the internal HTTP server from spinning on socket exceptions
It addresses an uncommon edge case in the HTTP event loop, limiting its overall impact
